design.frame_primary_technical: Pre-2010 Population and Housing Census Enumeration Frame, GSS population estimates
design.frame_conflict: Some survey summary descriptions refer to 2010 PHC frame; original codebook explicitly says pre-2010 while weight calibration explicitly uses 2010 census: official origin/versions unresolved
stages: numbered card randomly drawn by household member among eligible sex
design.sample_substitution: 7 EAs (2.3%); respondent refusal and absence permit instructed household substitutions

national_weight.role: within country weighting by individual inclusion probabilities and region/gender/urban-rural/household/EA size; 2010 census adult distribution referenced in technical report

wave_2022.question: Q31
wave_2022.release_n_discrepancy: 2022 national TIR sample=2400 vs 2024 national codebook RESPNO upper endpoint GHA2369; public version/anonymization/post-field exclusion mechanism and file count not reconciled

design.frame: 2021 Adult Population and Housing Census frame
stages: tablet/computer random person selection within eligible sex

national_weights.name: withinwt_ea
national_weights.codebook_semantics: weights to EA level (old AB withinwt): region,gender,urban-rural,household/EA size

national_weights.name: withinwt_hh
national_weights.codebook_semantics: weights to HH level (new AB withinwt): region,gender,urban-rural,household/EA size and ADULT_CT

shared_and_unresolved.population: Adult citizen 18+ headline common; realized coverage/nonresponse/translation and changing frame/region arrangements not automatically invariant
shared_and_unresolved.original_questionnaire_meaning: same Ghana-specific democracy-satisfaction stem and response 0..4; same English-first instruction; no read code 0
shared_and_unresolved.measurement_recode: R5 refusal 998; R9 refusal 8; DK 9 and missing -1; 0 valid but distinct from satisfaction scale 1..4
shared_and_unresolved.country_region_stratum: 2012 10 regions; 2022 16 regions; no crosswave PSU pooling, distinct survey-year design and variance
shared_and_unresolved.source_technical: national codebooks list REGION and URBRUR, but these are not verified unique PSU IDs, stratum ID nor complete replicate-weight recipe
shared_and_unresolved.eligible_asked_routing: public original instruments indicate unconditional Q43/Q31 in democracy block; retained data item applicability and -1 routes require authorized frozen-source mapping
shared_and_unresolved.response_rate_differential: 72.9% versus 94.23%; selection/nonresponse bias not repaired by ordinary weights without evidence
shared_and_unresolved.release_bridge: Neither retained merged SAV SHA nor native mapped country columns and weights were opened, version matched or qualified

source_byte_inventory.evidence: existing repository inventory, not rehashed or source inspected

negative_gate: Do not infer R9 public country file row count solely from RESPNO label
Do not equate withinwt_hh and withinwt_ea, or silently transfer R5 withinwt

Do not infer official SAV version equality from survey title/question name
